C1436.title: Manta Network DDoS Attack Causes Gas Fee Spike
C1436.summary: In January 2024, Manta Network suffered an unauthorized DDoS attack that severely congested its RPC nodes. The attack caused a backlog of pending transactions, triggering a gas fee bidding war and forcing users to pay significantly higher-than-normal gas fees.
